name: Chandrashekhar
title: Software Engineer, Frontend (Angular)
headline: Frontend engineer who builds complex UIs (CAD/DXF viewers, PDF engines, data-extraction tools), now building the AI systems behind them.
shortBio: Software Engineer (3+ yrs, Angular) who built a custom Three.js CAD editor from scratch. Also: PDF/document tooling and real-time UIs; now growing into AI.
bio: I'm a Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience in frontend development, specializing in Angular, TypeScript and JavaScript. I build enterprise web applications with a focus on scalable UI architecture, reusable components, performance optimization and intuitive user experiences.

At VassarDigital.ai (and before that, Vassar Labs), I work on complex application features: CAD/DXF visualization, document processing, PDF viewers, data-extraction interfaces and API integrations. I enjoy solving challenging engineering problems and turning complex workflows into practical, user-friendly solutions.
Right now I'm expanding into backend and AI engineering (Python, Django/FastAPI, databases, authentication, system design, LLMs and RAG), and this portfolio is where I build it in public.
